title: Nature' Finch elevates ambition and determination in "ATM" feat. Dani Mitchell
htmlContent: "ATM," a new song by Nature' Finch and Dani Mitchell, is about turning desire into action. This song, one of the main singles from his upcoming album "What God Intended," celebrates going from failure to success. Finch is a well-known producer, engineer, writer, and artist, and he shows off all of his skills by playing every chord, note, and key himself. Finch's "ATM" is a song about getting out of poverty, and it tells that story through a mix of hip-hop and R&B. The lived experience is in determination in the face of challenges, effort mixed with melody, and success spreading its wings. Dani Mitchell's voice gives the song a lot of power, making it more than just a goal.  https://soundcloud.com/nature-finch/05-atm-feat-dani-mitchell-5 This piece is about having access, having the power to make choices, and having the right to seek a better life. Finch's choices in production make that point even clearer. "ATM" stands for both personal and artistic growth. The message is success is not a matter of luck but something you must think about, plan for, and work toward with all your might. As Finch gets ready to release the whole album, this single sets the tone for the entire thing, both musically and thematically. In "ATM," ambition turns into a spiritual legacy, and Nature' Finch wants to be great, and he also builds his own stairs and asks people to join him on the way up.
